Correction: the audit_serve failure was NOT a flake -- it was a genuine, deterministic test-isolation bug in e9d5's own new file tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/mutate/test_payload_shadow_effect_spies.py. Its effect_spies fixture patched socket.socket.connect/connect_ex via monkeypatch.setattr, which collided with the pre-existing autouse _network_guard fixture (tests/conftest.py, which patches the same attribute via unittest.mock.patch.object): monkeypatch's teardown does a plain setattr/delattr based on a stale local-dict snapshot rather than tracking whether the attribute was already local due to another active patch, so tearing down while _network_guard's patch was active left connect PERMANENTLY shadowed for every later test in the same pytest worker -- exactly reproducing 'Network access is forbidden' even on the allow_network-marked audit_serve test. Reproduced deterministically and reliably WITHOUT xdist/parallelism just by running this file's tests then test_audit_serve_heldout.py sequentially in one worker -- so 'only fails under full-suite parallel load' was a red herring; it fails any time this file's tests run before the audit_serve test in the same worker, parallel or not. Fixed by switching effect_spies's socket patches to unittest.mock.patch.object (the same safe mechanism _network_guard uses) and added a regression test (test_effect_spies_do_not_leak_socket_connect_into_later_tests) that reproduces the real file-ordering via tests/_nested_pytest.py's run_nested_pytest helper -- confirmed RED against the buggy fixture, GREEN with the fix. Landed as Gerrit change 2436 (merged as d46c332c6740), LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 on the fixed patchset. e9d5-c850-d505-4a5a is now closed.

The OTHER three failures this ticket names (test_atomic_completion_close.py x5, test_rebar_repo_isolation.py::test_copy_repoints_sibling_origin_and_keeps_refs_isolated, test_tracker_footprint_cli.py x2) are a SEPARATE, still-unresolved issue -- I independently confirmed today that these 8 tests fail even in ISOLATION (not just under full-suite/xdist load) on a completely clean, freshly-provisioned origin/main worktree (git worktree add + uv venv + editable install, no e9d5/6452 changes present at all). All 8 fail identically with 'git ... show-ref returned non-zero exit status 128' against ephemeral temp git repos, which looks like a local/host git-config or credential-helper interaction on THIS macOS host rather than a CI-observed failure mode -- I have not seen these fail in the actual GitHub Actions CI runs for changes 2435/2436 (those only ever failed on the audit_serve test, now fixed). Retargeting this ticket's scope to just these three (unrelated to socket/audit_serve) test files; the audit_serve/effect-spies root cause above is fully resolved and should not block this ticket's remaining work. Recommend the next person confirm whether these 3 tests also fail in actual CI (not just this local host) before further root-causing -- if they only fail on this local dev environment and never in CI, this may be a local-git-config artifact rather than a genuine test bug.
